root_agent.purpose: retrieve durable records, contract and continue work, select or delegate agents, route gated capabilities, observe results, learn, and settle save points

caller_contract.neutrality: no dependency on one user account, chat transcript, provider, or model implementation
caller_contract.authority_rule: every call supplies its current authority; caller, model, host, and interface labels never expand authority
caller_contract.structural_rule: human, llm, and internal-functional-unit interfaces cannot directly mutate Agent structure; only global-control with explicit current global-structure evidence can authorize the architecture owner route
caller_contract.privacy_rule: store bounded task contracts and metadata, never credentials, tokens, cookies, or raw private conversations

host_contract.input: PowerShell parameters or an equivalent JSON-to-parameter adapter
host_contract.output: machine-readable JSON with a typed exit plus repository-local durable state for accepted stateful calls
host_contract.compatibility: any host or model may call when it can access the repository, honor the manifest, and execute the registered local controller
host_contract.limitation: models without a compatible host adapter or repository authority cannot execute local capabilities; interface selection alone never elevates authority

specialist_agents.id_rule: specialist agent id equals the canonical active owner name
adapter_contract: typed triggers, inputs, outputs, and verification
result returns to the root Agent save point

concept_agents.purpose: restore context, normalize goals, gather evidence, design work, and execute through accountable owners

retrieve, search-before-store, upsert or supersede, consolidate, freeze, evaluate, repair, scan local private book shelves into derived learning lenses, score skill candidates, enforce strict improvement gates, promote, link, review memory-action traces, and return durable experience memory for later callers
produce and verify user deliverables through existing specialist owners
provide runtime, credential, installation, file-state, Git, version, and release capabilities behind their gates
observe the Agent, evolve its owner and capability contracts, validate replacement, score skill-evolution candidates through experience capture, and settle publication boundaries

dynamic_subagents.safety: delegation never expands authority or bypasses owner tool gates; concurrent writes to the same surface remain prohibited
dynamic_subagents.template_inheritance: Future child Agent profiles inherit the current content-hashed structural optimization baseline from config/minimal-agent-template.json before domain specialization; the seven feynman-build-workshop units remain a compatibility subset.

structural_optimization_inheritance.delegation_behavior: inject current snapshot and profile adaptation for every delegated Agent and fail closed when a named child profile is stale or lacks functional effect evidence

document_capability.skill_discovery: Codex bundled plugin discovery under the user .codex plugins cache
document_capability.evidence_contract: A successful provider must produce a PDF and raster PNG; OfficeCLI screenshots and structure-only checks are not render evidence.
document_capability.failure_behavior: Record the provider error and continue to the bounded Word-native fallback when the route is Auto.

upstream_full_repository.use_rule: read and execute only through the ppt-deck-factory owner contract; never copy large upstream examples, credentials, or runtime state into Git

child_agent_profiles.delegation_payload_policy: parent passes complete demand packet, source boundary, constraints, authority, and validation expectations; parent does not choose topic, thesis, outline, route, visual style, or template unless the user explicitly fixed them

classify request into route-plan, template-study, deck-authoring, validation, or repair before tool selection

iterate plan-author-render-validate-repair-settle with bounded loops and actual-render evidence when available
use Agent memory operations as a callable skill for PPT lessons, failures, and reusable design decisions at save points

child_agent_profiles.main_corpus_study_policy: codex-ppt is always the visual-authoring method for new decks; main-corpus study is required only when reconstruct-editable-pptx or an explicitly selected pure-native route needs downstream native PowerPoint techniques

image_backend_reliability.connection_failure_policy: on connection failed 5/5, stop new dispatches, preserve recorded slides, and retry only the affected slide once after the queue is idle

readability_gate.contact_sheet_rule: hard-to-read body text requires authoring-source repair and regeneration

child_agent_profiles.merge_verifier: selected specialist owner delivery gate plus parent JoinSubagent evidence hash check
child_agent_profiles.authority_boundary: child Agent can plan and coordinate visual artifacts, use approved local visual methods, and capture privacy-safe design templates; the selected specialist owner retains format validation, data-fidelity, credential, dependency, Git, release, publication, and structural-change gates

child_agent_profiles.delegation_payload_policy: parent passes the complete life/career request, source boundary, personal-data write surface, current authority, requested mode when fixed, and validation expectations; child selects the smallest route and asks for missing personal facts instead of inventing them

continuation.identity: session id plus durable state, not caller or model identity
continuation.cross_caller_rule: a new authorized caller or model may Resume or Continue from an idle save point and becomes the current caller context
continuation.unsafe_boundary: unfinished non-idempotent work is marked interrupted and is never silently replayed
